meta.name: creator-registry
meta.description: Use when the user asks "what did we pay this creator last time" or to "update the creator roster"; maintains one durable record per creator — verified handles, rate history, exclusivity windows, dated compliance events, performance baselines. Not for scoring fit — use fit-scorer; not for reviewing content — use content-reviewer. 创作者档案/达人名册

copy.tagline: 管理创作者档案与历史记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要维护创作者名册、查看历史合作费用。
copy.tagline_en: Manage creator profiles and historical records
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to maintain a creator roster and look up past payments.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以查询或更新每位创作者的档案，包括已验证的社交媒体账号、历史报价、独家合作期限、合规事件记录和过往表现基准。它不会评分或审核内容，只存储事实。
howto.when: 当用户询问创作者的过往报价、独家合作到期时间，或要求更新创作者名册时触发。也适用于活动结束后整合创作者记录。

say.text: 我们上次付给 @sarah_ig 多少钱？
say.note: Claude 会查询该创作者的档案并返回历史报价。

say.text: 更新 @creatorhandle 的档案，春季活动刚结束。
say.note: Claude 会合并活动结果并更新记录。

say.text: 检查 @creatorhandle 的独家合作是否即将到期。
say.note: Claude 会查看独家合作窗口并提醒到期时间。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query or update each creator's record, including verified handles, rate history, exclusivity windows, dated compliance events, and performance baselines. It stores facts only, never scores or judges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a creator's past payment, exclusivity lapse, or requests to update the creator roster. Also used after a campaign closes to consolidate the creator's record.

say_en.text: How much did we pay @sarah_ig last time?
say_en.note: Claude will look up the creator's record and return the rate history.

say_en.text: Consolidate the record for @creatorhandle after the spring campaign.
say_en.note: Claude will merge campaign outcomes and update the record.

say_en.text: Check if @creatorhandle's exclusivity is expiring soon.
say_en.note: Claude will review exclusivity windows and flag upcoming expirations.
